text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting on her performance in the race, 
Curren Chan cleanly gave up on the Triple 
Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in order to master the way of 
cuteness, she changed her goal to 
"becoming the most loved Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, setting the pinnacle of sprints, 
the Sprinters Stakes, as the ultimate 
goal, she decided to regain her feel for 
the 1,200m distance at the Aoi Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, apart from the race 
schedule, she began plotting something or 
other.
